news.title: The art and science of ‘A Christmas Carol’
news.summary_en: The ISU Theatre's new adaptation of "A Christmas Carol" features more than 80 handcrafted puppets, highlighting the intersection of art and science as students draw on design, engineering and problem-solving skills to turn imagination into movement.

news.title: Favorable climate helped corn spread across Americas and hybridize in highlands
news.summary_en: An unusually wet period in the Mexican highlands may have helped ancient corn mix with a higher-altitude variety to create the hybrid that’s the genetic ancestor of most modern versions of the crop, new research led by an Iowa State University anthropologist shows.

news.title: Family farmer from Northeast Iowa to be honored in 2026 Gold Star Hall Ceremony
news.summary_en: Iowa State student, farmer and accomplished vocalist George Howard Clarke devoted himself to agriculture, family and service before becoming a U.S. Army Air Forces navigator whose life was cut short at age 27 in a 1943 plane crash in Greenland during World War II.

news.title: Engineering graduate to be honored in 2026 Gold Star Hall ceremony
news.summary_en: 1st Lt. Russell Trenary's love of flying carried him from campus life and football sidelines to combat missions over Europe. He was killed at age 27 when his P-47 Thunderbolt crashed in France during World War II.

news.title: Vietnam War pilot to be honored in 2026 Gold Star Hall Ceremony
news.summary_en: An Iowa State alumnus whose passion for agriculture and aviation led him from a farm near Maxwell to the cockpit of a KC-135 tanker, 1st Lt. Richard Welch was killed at age 24 during a catastrophic Vietnam War mission, leaving behind a legacy of service, ambition and sacrifice.

news.title: Purple Heart recipient to be honored at the 2026 Gold Star Hall Ceremony
news.summary_en: Richard “Dick” Swift, an Iowa State engineering graduate, decorated Air Force officer and Apollo program supporter, rose from humble beginnings in Des Moines to contribute to America’s early space efforts before making the ultimate sacrifice during a Vietnam War reconnaissance mission in 1968.
